_doc: 평가 질문셋 30문항 (명세 §19): 증상 12 · 기분 8 · 설명 10. 2026-11-14 행사 중에 손으로 작성. 학습셋(ml/data/symptoms) 문장과 겹치지 않는지는 run_eval.py --check 로 확인한다. 문장은 결과를 본 뒤 고치지 않는다(고치면 버전을 올린다).

symptom.text: My left knee hurts when I bend it
일어서는 순간 눈앞이 하얘지고 몸이 휘청해요
I can't seem to catch my breath after walking to the galley
요즘 아무것도 재미가 없고 그냥 멍해요
이대로 사라져 버리면 좋겠다는 생각이 자꾸 들어요
No chest pain, just a stuffy nose since last night
오늘 headache가 좀 있고 eyes가 침침해요
특별히 불편한 데 없어요, 컨디션 좋아요

mood.text: 오늘은 그냥 다 귀찮고 축 처져요
푹 자서 그런지 몸이 가볍고 기분도 좋아요
Deadline pressure is getting to me, I keep snapping at people
잠을 거의 못 자서 눈이 감겨요. 기분은 나쁘지 않아요
I feel great, the EVA went perfectly
가족 생각에 좀 울적하지만 일은 할 만해요

paragraphs._doc: 평가용으로 쓴 자리 채움 문단이다. NASA 문서 원문이 아니다. 코퍼스가 생기면 실제 문단 id로 바꾼다.
paragraphs.eval:orthostatic#p1: After a fluid shift, standing up quickly can lower blood pressure and cause lightheadedness. Stand up slowly and hold a handrail.
paragraphs.eval:fluids#p1: Low fluid intake raises resting heart rate. Drink water with electrolytes and recheck heart rate after resting.
paragraphs.eval:sleep#p1: Short sleep lowers alertness the next day. Schedule precision tasks later in the morning and keep caffeine before noon.
paragraphs.eval:sleep#p2: Several short nights in a row raise fatigue and lower mood. Protect the next sleep period and dim lights before sleep.
paragraphs.eval:motion#p1: Motion sickness is common during adaptation. Limit rapid head movements and keep meals light.
paragraphs.eval:co2#p1: Elevated cabin carbon dioxide can cause headache and poor concentration. Move to a well ventilated area and report the location.
paragraphs.eval:msk#p1: After a strain, reduce exercise load for the affected area and avoid sudden twisting. Resume gradually.
paragraphs.eval:uri#p1: Raised skin temperature with a higher heart rate can accompany an upper airway illness. Rest, drink fluids and limit close contact.
paragraphs.eval:mood#p1: Low mood with poor sleep is common during long isolation. Keep the daily routine, exercise, and talk with a crewmate or the flight surgeon.
paragraphs.eval:skin#p1: Skin irritation is common under sensors and straps. Keep the area dry and move the wearable to the other wrist.
